Pet artwork provenance
======================
Upstream project: https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet  (default branch: main)
Local clone used: C:/Users/ASUS/AppData/Local/Temp/dsh-pet
Downloaded from:  raw.githubusercontent.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet/main/dsh-pet/assets/webm/

animations/*.webm are unmodified transparent VP9-alpha clips from the
official dsh-pet asset set (640x360). Renamed to ASCII keys for the web:

  landing.webm   = 原地重力下蹲压缩
  walk.webm      = 螃蟹走路            (loop)
  idle.webm      = 待机呼吸休闲
  look-around.webm = 东张西望
  daze.webm      = 碎碎念-发呆碎碎念
  yawn.webm      = 哈欠连天
  stretch.webm   = 超大伸懒腰
  sleep.webm     = 原地小憩沉眠        (loop)
  wake.webm      = 打瞌睡被惊醒
  drag.webm      = 被鼠标拖拽悬空反馈  (loop)
  wave.webm      = 点击回应-元气挥手
  happy.webm     = 点击回应-开心跃动
  huffy.webm     = 点击回应-傲娇生气

mascot.png is a still frame extracted locally from the official 待机呼吸休闲
(idle.webm) clip at ~0.6s, exported losslessly from the video's own pixels so
the standing pose matches the animation character exactly (blue twin-tail
whale girl). Earlier derivative stills (dsh-whale.png, glm.png) were removed
to keep a single character; stored petSkin values migrate to mascot.

Character and licensing (per upstream README):
  Character: "大肥鱼" whale girl — original character 溟月 by Bilibili user
  @上善无形, DeepSeek derivative by @ZipZipPipe. Not an official DeepSeek mascot.
  Code: MIT. Animation assets / prompts / source videos: open-source use
  allowed, commercial use prohibited. Character design: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 —
  derivatives must publicly credit the upstream repository.

This project is personal, non-commercial use. No additional rights over the
artwork are asserted here; redistribution or commercial use requires the
upstream rights holders' permission.
